title: cyperus rigens subsp. cephalanthus
intro: Cyperus rigens subsp. cephalanthus, commonly known as the papyrus sedge, is a species of sedge in the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential remedy for wounds, infections, and other health issues. The therapeutic actions of papyrus sedge include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Cyperus rigens subsp. cephalanthus include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
